Property name.hint: The official name of the building, mall, or centre where the leased premises are located.
Property name.look_in: Cover page, recitals, header, property description section.
Property name.format: Proper noun string, e.g. 'Mall of the Emirates', 'One Canada Square'.
Property name.exclude: Do not return the tenant's company name or city name alone.

Street.hint: Street name only (no number) for the property address.
Street.look_in: Property address block, cover page, recitals.
Street.format: Street name string, e.g. 'Sheikh Zayed Road'.
Street.exclude: Do not include street number here.

Street no.hint: Street number or building number for the property address.
Street no.exclude: Do not include street name here.

Postal code.hint: Postcode, ZIP, or P.O. Box number for the licensed/leased premises (property location only). In UAE and similar markets the premises P.O. Box on the mall/site or licensor-at-premises block counts as the property postal code — extract the number only (e.g. 60811 from 'P.O. Box 60811').
Postal code.look_in: Cover page, recitals, premises/site description, licensed property address, mall name block, Exhibit A / schedule showing the unit location, and licensor notice address when it is clearly the same site as the premises.
Postal code.format: Digits/alphanumeric only — no words like 'P.O. Box'. Examples: '60811', '10001', 'SW1A 1AA'.
Postal code.exclude: Do NOT use the tenant's separate correspondence P.O. Box if it is a different address. Do NOT return N/A when the premises or licensor-at-site block shows P.O. Box or postcode.

City.hint: City where the leased property is located.
City.look_in: Property address, cover page, jurisdiction clause.
City.exclude: Do not return country or state alone.

County.hint: County, emirate, or administrative district of the property.

State / province.hint: State, province, or emirate where the property is located.
State / province.look_in: Property address, governing law, jurisdiction clause.

Country.hint: Country where the property is located or where the agreement is governed.
Country.look_in: Property address, governing law clause, cover page.
Country.format: Full country name, e.g. 'United Arab Emirates', 'United Kingdom'.
Country.exclude: Do not abbreviate to UAE or UK unless document does so.

Building Type.look_in: Property description, recitals, permitted use clause.
Building Type.format: Short descriptor, e.g. 'Shopping Centre', 'Office Building', 'Retail Mall'.
Building Type.exclude: Do not return the tenant's business type.

Total building area.hint: Total gross area of the entire building or centre (not just the leased unit).
Total building area.format: Number only or number with UOM, e.g. '250000' or '250,000 sq ft'.
Total building area.exclude: Do not return the leased unit area here. N/A if not stated.

UOM.hint: Unit of measure for the total building area.
UOM.exclude: N/A if total building area is not stated.

Landlord Name.hint: Full legal name of the Licensor/Landlord — the party granting the lease.
Landlord Name.look_in: Parties clause, cover page, recitals, signature block.
Landlord Name.format: Full legal entity name including legal suffix (LLC, L.L.C, Ltd, PLC, etc.).
Landlord Name.example: Majid Al Futtaim Mall Of The Emirates L.L.C
Landlord Name.exclude: Do NOT return the tenant/licensee name here. Must be the party granting the right.

Tenant Name.hint: Full legal name of the Licensee/Tenant — the party receiving the right to occupy.
Tenant Name.look_in: Parties clause, cover page, recitals, signature block.
Tenant Name.format: Full legal entity name including legal suffix.
Tenant Name.example: HSBC Bank Middle East Limited Dubai Branch
Tenant Name.exclude: Do NOT return the landlord/licensor name here. Must be the occupying party.

Unit/suite number.hint: The identifier of the specific leased unit, suite, or FSU within the building.
Unit/suite number.look_in: Premises description, license details table, annexures.
Unit/suite number.exclude: Do not return the floor number alone.

Type.hint: Area.{i}.Type = premises/unit category from the license details table or unit schedule (NOT permitted-use narrative). Examples: Commercial Bank, Commercial Block, Retail, Office, Banking.
Type.look_in: License details table, premises schedule, Exhibit A unit row for this suite. Use the explicit 'Type' / unit category column or label beside Unit/suite number.
Type.format: Short phrase exactly as stated for the unit (e.g. 'Commercial Bank', 'Commercial Block').
Type.exclude: Do NOT use generic zone labels ('Designated Area', 'Licensed Area', 'FSU', 'Designated FSU') unless that exact phrase is the unit Type in the table. Do not return Building Type or mall zone name here.

Gross area.hint: Gross lettable or licensed area of the specific leased unit/premises.
Gross area.look_in: Premises description, area schedule, license details, annexure.
Gross area.format: Number only, e.g. '17.46'. Do NOT include UOM in this field.
Gross area.exclude: Do not return total building area. Do not include sq m or sq ft here.

Gross Area UOM.hint: Unit of measure for the gross area of the leased premises.
Gross Area UOM.look_in: Same location as gross area figure.
Gross Area UOM.exclude: N/A if gross area is not stated.

Net area.hint: Net internal area of the leased premises if stated separately from gross.
Net area.look_in: Area schedule, premises description, technical annexure.
Net area.exclude: N/A if not separately stated. Do NOT copy gross area here.

Net Area UOM.hint: Unit of measure for net area.
Net Area UOM.exclude: N/A if net area not stated.

Floor no..hint: Floor level where the leased premises are located.
Floor no..look_in: Premises description, unit description, license details.

Start date.hint: Commencement date of the lease term or area schedule.
Start date.look_in: Term clause, area schedule, license details table.
Start date.format: Date as stated, prefer dd/mm/yyyy. e.g. '31/01/2026'.
Start date.exclude: Do not return execution date or signing date here.

End date.hint: Expiry or termination date of the lease term.
End date.look_in: Term clause, area schedule, license details table.
End date.format: Date as stated, prefer dd/mm/yyyy. e.g. '30/01/2029'.
End date.exclude: Do not return notice period expiry or option exercise date.

Duration.hint: Length of the lease or area term expressed as a period.
Duration.format: Period string, e.g. '3 years', '36 months', '3 (Three) Years'.
Duration.exclude: Do not return start or end dates here.

Effective Date.hint: The date the agreement becomes legally effective, often the date stated on the cover or recitals.
Effective Date.look_in: Cover page recital: 'This agreement is made on [date]', opening line.
Effective Date.format: Date as stated, e.g. '15 January, 2026' or '15/01/2026'.
Effective Date.exclude: Different from execution/signing date if both stated.

Execution Date.hint: Date the agreement was actually signed/executed by the parties.
Execution Date.look_in: Signature block, execution clause, cover page.
Execution Date.exclude: N/A if not separately stated from effective date.

Original Commencement Date.hint: The very first start date of the ORIGINAL/PRIOR lease term — NOT the current renewal term.
Original Commencement Date.look_in: Recitals of renewal/amendment ('original term commenced', 'prior agreement'), definitions.
Original Commencement Date.exclude: Never copy Current Commencement Date here on renewals. N/A if original (not renewal) lease and not stated.

Rent Commencement Date.hint: The date from which rent or license fee payments begin to accrue.
Rent Commencement Date.look_in: Payment terms, rent commencement clause, license details, Exhibit A.
Rent Commencement Date.exclude: May differ from lease commencement if rent-free period applies.

Current Commencement Date.hint: The commencement date of THIS agreement's current term (renewal/amendment period or original lease start).
Current Commencement Date.look_in: Term clause, License Term table, renewal recitals, license details.
Current Commencement Date.exclude: Do not use prior/original term dates. On original base leases, same as lease commencement.

Current Expiration Date.hint: The expiry date of the current term.
Current Expiration Date.look_in: Term clause, license details, payment schedule.
Current Expiration Date.exclude: Do not return option/renewal expiry dates.

Original Expiration Date.hint: The expiry date of the ORIGINAL/PRIOR term before this renewal — NOT Current Expiration.
Original Expiration Date.look_in: Recitals of renewal/amendment ('original term expired', 'prior agreement').
Original Expiration Date.exclude: Never copy Current Expiration Date here on renewals. N/A if original lease and not stated.

Possession Date.hint: Date the tenant takes physical possession of the premises.
Possession Date.look_in: Possession clause, handover clause, conditions precedent.
Possession Date.exclude: N/A if not stated. Different from commencement date if fitout period applies.

Delivery Date.hint: Date the landlord delivers the premises to the tenant.

Term Duration.hint: Overall duration of the entire lease term.
Term Duration.look_in: Term clause, cover page, license details.
Term Duration.format: Period string with number and unit, e.g. '3 years', '5 years 6 months'.
Term Duration.exclude: Must contain a number and time unit. Do not return dates.

Lease Status.hint: Current status of the lease agreement.
Lease Status.look_in: Cover page, execution block, agreement type.
Lease Status.exclude: N/A if status cannot be determined.

Contact Type.hint: The role or party label for this contact block.
Contact Type.look_in: Parties clause — match index to the correct party (0=Licensor/Landlord, 1=Licensee/Tenant, 2+=other).
Contact Type.exclude: Do not mix up landlord and tenant blocks.

Name.hint: Full legal name for this specific contact block party.
Name.look_in: Parties clause, signature block — for the index indicated.
Name.format: Full legal name with entity suffix.
Name.example: Majid Al Futtaim Mall Of The Emirates L.L.C
Name.exclude: Must match the party for this contact index. Do not copy wrong party name.

Attention.hint: Attention line or named individual for notices to this party.
Attention.look_in: Notices clause, contact details for this party.
Attention.format: Person name or title, e.g. 'The Legal Director'.

Care of.hint: C/O or care of line for this contact.

DBA.hint: Trading name or 'doing business as' name for this party.

Suite.hint: Suite number within the party's contact address (not the leased premises).
Suite.look_in: Contact address block for this party in notices clause.
Suite.exclude: N/A if not stated. Do not use leased premises suite number.

P.O. Box.hint: PO Box number for this party's contact address.
P.O. Box.format: PO Box number only, e.g. '60811' or 'P O Box 60811'.

Zip code.hint: ZIP/postal code for THIS contact party's address only.
Zip code.look_in: This party's address block in parties clause or notices.
Zip code.exclude: N/A if not stated for this party. NEVER copy property postal code here.

Phone.hint: Telephone number for this contact party.

Mobile.hint: Mobile/cell phone number for this contact party.

Fax.hint: Fax number for this contact party.

Email.hint: Email address for this contact party.

Additional address details.hint: Any address information for this party not captured in other fields — building name, floor, area, landmark.

Rent Type.hint: Classification of this expense/rent row, e.g. Base Rent, License Fee, Service Charge.
Rent Type.look_in: Payment terms, Exhibit A, rent schedule.
Rent Type.exclude: Do not return a date or amount here.

Monthly Amount.hint: Monthly rent/expense amount for this expense row.
Monthly Amount.look_in: Payment schedule, Exhibit A, rent table.
Monthly Amount.format: Number only without currency, e.g. '172431.27'. Derive from annual if needed (annual/12).
Monthly Amount.exclude: Do not include currency symbol. N/A if only annual is stated and cannot divide.

Monthly Amount per SF.hint: Monthly amount per square foot or square metre.

Annual Amount.hint: Annual rent or expense amount for this expense row.
Annual Amount.look_in: Payment schedule, Exhibit A, license fee table.
Annual Amount.exclude: Do not include VAT. Do not include currency symbol.

Annual amount per SF.hint: Annual amount per square foot or square metre.

Currency.hint: Currency code or name for this expense row.
Currency.look_in: Payment terms, rent schedule, license details.
Currency.format: ISO currency code or full name, e.g. 'AED', 'USD', 'GBP', 'HKD'.
Currency.exclude: Do not return symbol like $ or £ alone.

On Day.hint: Day of the month on which payment is due.

Payment Frequency.hint: How often rent/expense payments are made.

Default.hint: Summarize the default and remedies clause — what constitutes default and what happens.
Default.look_in: Default clause, remedies clause, consequences of breach.
Default.format: Concise summary of key default triggers and remedies.
Default.example: Licensor may impose default penalty of AED 2,000/day for each day of default. Security deposit may be applied.
Default.exclude: Lease is silent ONLY if no default/remedy clause exists anywhere.

Estoppel.hint: Summarize any estoppel certificate or non-disturbance provisions.
Estoppel.exclude: Lease is silent if no estoppel clause found after full search.

Business Hours.hint: Operating/business hours requirements for the premises.
Business Hours.look_in: Hours of operation clause, rules and regulations, annexures.
Business Hours.exclude: Lease is silent only if not addressed anywhere including annexures.

Late Charges.hint: Penalty or interest for late payment of rent.
Late Charges.look_in: Late payment clause, default clause, payment terms.
Late Charges.format: Summary with amount or rate if stated.
Late Charges.example: Default penalty of AED 2,000 per day applies.
Late Charges.exclude: Lease is silent only if no late charge provision exists.

Repair and Maintenance.hint: Who is responsible for repairs and maintenance of the premises.
Repair and Maintenance.look_in: Repair and maintenance clause, tenant obligations.
Repair and Maintenance.example: Tenant responsible for maintaining FSU in good condition per Visual Merchandising Guidelines.
Repair and Maintenance.exclude: Lease is silent only if not addressed.

Insurance Requirements.hint: Insurance obligations for landlord and/or tenant.
Insurance Requirements.exclude: Lease is silent if no insurance clause found.

Parking.look_in: Parking clause, rules and regulations, annexures.
Parking.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Signage.hint: Signage rights and restrictions for the tenant.
Signage.look_in: Signage clause, visual merchandising guidelines, rules.
Signage.example: Signage design and size subject to Licensor's prior written approval.
Signage.exclude: Lease is silent only if no signage provision anywhere.

Surrender.hint: Obligations upon surrender or expiry of the lease.
Surrender.look_in: Surrender clause, consequences of termination, expiry obligations.
Surrender.example: Tenant must cease operations, remove FSU, vacate premises, and settle all accounts within 1 week.
Surrender.exclude: Lease is silent only if not addressed.

Holdover.hint: What happens if tenant remains in occupation after lease expiry.
Holdover.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Permitted Use.hint: The specific use(s) the tenant is permitted to conduct at the premises.
Permitted Use.look_in: Permitted use clause, description of services, license details.
Permitted Use.exclude: Do not return general property use type.

Assignment/Sublet.hint: Whether tenant can assign the lease or sublet the premises.
Assignment/Sublet.example: Assignment not permitted without prior written consent of Licensor.
Assignment/Sublet.exclude: Lease is silent only if not addressed.

Alterations.hint: Tenant rights to make alterations or improvements to the premises.
Alterations.look_in: Alterations clause, fitout clause, tenant works.
Alterations.example: No alterations without prior written approval of Licensor.
Alterations.exclude: Lease is silent only if not addressed.

Operating Expenses.hint: Tenant's obligations for operating expenses, CAM, or service charges.
Operating Expenses.look_in: Operating expenses clause, service charge clause, CAM provisions.
Operating Expenses.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

RE Taxes.hint: Real estate tax obligations and allocation between landlord and tenant.
RE Taxes.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed. Note VAT separately.

Property Insurance.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Restricted Uses.hint: Uses that are restricted but not fully prohibited.
Restricted Uses.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Prohibited Uses.hint: Uses that are explicitly prohibited at the premises.
Prohibited Uses.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Exclusive Use.hint: Any exclusive use rights granted to the tenant.
Exclusive Use.look_in: Exclusive use clause. Note: non-exclusive licenses may explicitly state no exclusivity.
Exclusive Use.example: License is non-exclusive. Licensor may grant similar licenses to others.
Exclusive Use.exclude: Lease is silent only if not mentioned at all.

Percentage Rent (Payment).hint: Any percentage rent or turnover rent payment obligations.
Percentage Rent (Payment).look_in: Percentage rent clause, turnover rent provisions.
Percentage Rent (Payment).exclude: N/A if explicitly stated as N/A in document. Lease is silent if not addressed.

Gross Sales (Reporting).hint: Tenant's obligations to report gross sales figures.
Gross Sales (Reporting).look_in: Gross sales reporting clause, percentage rent provisions.
Gross Sales (Reporting).exclude: N/A if percentage rent is N/A.

Go dark.hint: Tenant's right to cease operations while continuing to pay rent.
Go dark.look_in: Go dark clause, continuous operation clause.
Go dark.example: Tenant must remain open during all Centre operating hours. Closure penalty applies.
Go dark.exclude: Lease is silent only if continuous operation requirements not addressed.

Co-Tenancy.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Radius Restrictions.hint: Geographic restrictions on tenant opening competing locations.
Radius Restrictions.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Tenant Improvement Allowance.hint: Any allowance paid by landlord toward tenant's fitout or improvements.
Tenant Improvement Allowance.look_in: TI allowance clause, fitout contribution, landlord works.
Tenant Improvement Allowance.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Brokers.exclude: Lease is silent if not addressed.

Notices.hint: Notice provisions — how and where notices must be served.
Notices.format: Summary of notice requirements and addresses.
Notices.example: Notices to be served at addresses stated in the License.
Notices.exclude: Lease is silent only if no notices clause at all.

Base Rent Comments.hint: Any special comments, notes, or conditions relating to base rent or license fee.
Base Rent Comments.look_in: Payment terms, Exhibit A, rent schedule, footnotes.
Base Rent Comments.format: Free text summary of any special rent terms.
Base Rent Comments.example: License Fee increases annually. Year 1: AED 656,376. Year 2: AED 689,194.80. Year 3: AED 723,654.48.

Utilities.look_in: Utilities clause, mechanical electrical plumbing provisions, rules and regulations.
Utilities.example: Electricity provided by Licensor at no extra charge during operating hours.
Utilities.exclude: Lease is silent only if not addressed anywhere.

contact_index.0: Landlord / Lessor / Licensor — primary notice block. Extract full address, phone, email for landlord only.
contact_index.1: Tenant / Lessee / Licensee — primary notice block. Extract full address, phone, email for tenant only.
contact_index.2: Payment / remittance contact — cheques payable, AP, accounts payable, wire, lockbox, rent payment address when distinct from .0/.1.
contact_index.3: Additional party — counsel, broker, guarantor, property manager, contractor, or other named notice addressee.
contact_index.4: Additional party — further notice copy, legal, or email-only contact (fill Email even if address is N/A).
contact_index.5: Witness or signatory contact block if listed separately from landlord/tenant.

clause_value_format: Detailed factual abstraction (3-8 sentences): state rights, obligations, notice periods, amounts, caps, conditions, and exceptions as written. Not a one-line summary. If silent after full search, use Lease is silent.
clauses_group_note: CLAUSE FIELDS — value must be a detailed factual abstraction of what the lease states (not a one-line summary). Include specific triggers, notice periods, amounts, approval requirements, and party obligations. context must quote the operative clause sentence(s). Search ALL pages, schedules, rules, and annexures before Lease is silent.
date_fields_note: DATE FIELDS — context MUST contain the exact lease sentence or table cell with the date. Execution Date = signature block date when stated (not cover 'made on' unless no signature date). Effective Date = agreement made/effective date on cover or recitals. Current Expiration must be after Current Commencement. Rent Commencement may follow Current Commencement if a rent-free period applies.
repeatable_slots_note: REPEATABLE SLOTS: items[] order maps to .0, .1, .2 … in Excel. Return ONE object per distinct row — all fields for that row in ONE object. For Contacts: core landlord/tenant/payment/notice parties only (.0 Landlord → .1 Tenant → .2+ notice/payment roles). For Expenses: one item per rent-schedule year or charge line with a stated dollar amount. Continue .2, .3 … only when additional distinct rows exist; do not pad empty slots.
contacts_group_note:
CONTACT IDENTIFICATION — CORE PARTIES ONLY:
- Extract Landlord/Lessor, Tenant/Lessee, Payment Contact, and Notice Copy for those parties. Same entity may appear multiple times with different Contact Type.
- Do NOT extract contractors, utilities, property managers, county attorneys, exhibit vendors, or brokers unless they are a core party notice addressee.
- ONE items[] object per contact = ALL address fields together (Street, City, Zip in the SAME item). NEVER split Street, City, Zip across separate items.
- SLOT ORDER: .0 primary Landlord/Lessor → .1 primary Tenant/Lessee → .2+ additional Notice Copy or Payment Contact for core parties.
- Fill all stated fields; N/A only when truly absent for that block.
area_group_note: AREA — one item per distinct premises/space row (.0, .1, .2+ for multiple suites, floors, or phased areas). Type = unit category from the table (e.g. Commercial Bank), not generic zone headings like 'Designated Area'. Match Type to the same row as unit number and area figures.
options_group_note: OPTIONS — one item per distinct option (renewal, expansion, termination, purchase, relocation, etc.). Use .2, .3, … for each additional option beyond the first two; do not combine multiple option rights into one item.
security_deposit_group_note: SECURITY DEPOSIT — one item per separate deposit obligation (cash, letter of credit, guarantor deposit, top-up, holdover). Use .2+ when the lease states more than two deposit types or tranches.
allowance_group_note: ALLOWANCE — one item per distinct allowance (TI, rent abatement, moving allowance, landlord contribution). Use .2+ for each separate allowance with its own amount or deadline.
expenses_group_note:
EXPENSES group (critical):
- items[0] (Expenses.0) = CURRENT lease term / first lease year rent — NOT a prior or historical period.
- Expenses.0 Start date and End date MUST match Current Commencement Date and Current Expiration Date from Pass 1 when those are known.
- One items[] entry per rent-schedule year/period or recurring charge line WITH a stated dollar amount (including $0.00).
- Do NOT create expense items for narrative-only charges (utilities, personal property tax estimates) with no amount — those belong in clause summaries.
- Rent escalation tables: each LEASE YEAR row with ANNUAL/MONTHLY = separate item.
- US retail/office: map 'Fixed Rent' / 'Base Rent' schedule rows; fill Annual Amount and Monthly Amount when both appear.
- CAM/insurance/tax only when amount is stated (0.00 is valid). Rent Type must be a label whenever any amount is extracted.
- Use commencement/term dates to set Start/End per lease year when the table lacks calendar dates.
core_address_note:
PROPERTY ADDRESS (this pass — flat fields only):
- Postal code: postcode, ZIP, or P.O. Box number for the licensed premises / mall / site. Return the numeric/alphanumeric code only (e.g. 60811), never the words 'P.O. Box'.
- Search cover page, recitals, premises or site clause, Exhibit A, and licensor notice address when it is the same location as the premises.
- Do not return N/A for Postal code when any premises or licensor-at-site address shows P.O. Box or postcode.

pass_notes.core: Focus on: property name/address (including Street, Postal code from premises P.O. Box), landlord name, tenant name, building type, term duration, lease status, AND all date fields (Effective, Execution, Original/Current Commencement/Expiration, Rent Commencement, Possession). For each date: quote the exact source sentence in context. Also extract Options, Security Deposit, and Allowance repeatables. Search License Details, recitals, signature blocks, and property blocks.
pass_notes.renewal_dates: RENEWAL / AMENDMENT agreements: Original Commencement and Original Expiration = the PRIOR term only (from recitals, 'original term commenced', 'prior agreement'). Current Commencement / Current Expiration = THIS renewal term (License Term / current period table). Execution Date = date in SIGNATURE block when parties signed — NOT the cover 'made on' date unless no signature date exists. Effective Date = agreement made/effective date on cover or recitals. Never copy current term dates into Original Commencement/Expiration fields. context must quote the recital or table cell for each date.
pass_notes.options_deposit: Dedicated pass for Options, Security Deposit, and Allowance only. OPTIONS: extract every termination, break/cancel, relocation, renewal, and expiry right as separate items[] rows (Rolling Cancel, Relocation, Lease Expiry, etc.) with option type, status, effective/end dates, notice deadlines, and comments. SECURITY DEPOSIT: Cash/LC type, currency, amount, payment date, return date, comments from License Details table.
pass_notes.contacts: Extract contact details for each party block by index. Index 0 = Landlord/Licensor. Index 1 = Tenant/Licensee. Index 2+ = other named parties. CRITICAL: Do NOT copy landlord details into tenant fields or vice versa. For absent sub-fields use N/A. Do NOT use property postal code as contact zip code.
pass_notes.core_deposit_allowance: Extract Security Deposit, Allowance, and Options repeatables: one items[] entry per distinct deposit/allowance/option (.0, .1, .2+ — do not stop at two if the lease lists more).
pass_notes.contacts_area: Extract Contact Identification and Area. CORE PARTIES ONLY: .0 Landlord/Lessor, .1 Tenant/Lessee, .2+ payment/notice roles for those parties. All address fields in ONE item per contact. Area: one item per premises row.
pass_notes.expenses_options: Dedicated pass for Expenses and Options. Search SECTION 4 / Fixed Rent / rent schedules / Exhibits / Additional Rent; one Expenses item per lease-year or charge line. Options = renewal/expansion/termination rights.
pass_notes.expenses: Dedicated pass for rent and money. Expenses.0 = current term — Start/End dates must align with Current Commencement/Expiration from Pass 1 (see CONFIRMED KEY FACTS). One item per lease-year or charge line WITH a stated dollar amount only. Do not pad future years or narrative charges without amounts. Security deposits and TI allowances go in their own groups, not Expenses.
pass_notes.area_options: Extract Area and Options repeatable groups only. One Area item per distinct premises/space row; Options per renewal/expansion/termination option found.
pass_notes.clauses: Search ALL operative clauses, general terms, standard terms, rules and regulations, and all annexures. Provide a detailed factual abstraction for each clause field (rights, obligations, notice periods, amounts, conditions) — not a one-line summary. context = verbatim supporting quote. Only use 'Lease is silent.' if the topic is genuinely not addressed ANYWHERE after exhaustive search.
